clips.title: The story
paras: At Southpoint Tower, Deathstalker Lesh watches the human farms in the Hillsbrad Foothills. She serves High Executor Darthalia and gauges when the Forsaken should strike.

From Southpoint Tower, Deathstalker Lesh watches the human farmers and town militia in the nearby Hillsbrad Fields. The tower stands on the southern road through the Hillsbrad Foothills. Lesh belongs to the Deathstalkers, the Forsaken's covert network of scouts, spies, and assassins. She tracks enemy movements and numbers for High Executor Darthalia in Tarren Mill. When the moment is right, Lesh sends Darthalia a coded message: “The raven's cry from the west doth beckon.” The words signal that Hillsbrad is ripe for the Forsaken's attack.
